Summary: LABOR: admit officer and director relationships from SEC Forms 3, 4 and 5 (HAS_OFFICER_OR_DIRECTOR_DISCLOSURE), both parties by SEC CIK, role as the filing states it
Description: 1) Original intent: LABOR has no admitted relationship type (0 of 10 benchmark subjects). The Founder ratified (2026-10-12, Decision Record section 3) an officer-or-director relationship from Forms 3, 4 and 5: the issuer and the reporting person are identified by SEC CIKs and the filing itself states the role; name-only matching is not allowed; an insider form alone is not the relationship. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) the type is registered with the ratified admission rule: issuer and person both CIK-identified, the filing's own isDirector or isOfficer flag true, a citable accession, source Forms 3, 4 or 5; ten-percent-owner-only and other-only filings are NOT admitted (ownership is a different relationship); (b) identity of the role: nu_id carries the role (DIRECTOR or OFFICER), nu_state the officer title as stated; a title change is RECONFIGURED, a repeat is PERSISTENT; (c) relevant time period: each admission carries the form, filing date and period of report, and the relationship is worded 'disclosed as of <date>' with no end inferred (a Form 4 does not state that a role ended); (d) the newest filing per person in the last 12 months is read; the cap on filings and persons is stated when reached; (e) the producer runs through the existing path: SEC search, document read, admitAndProject, canonical store, analytical snapshot, History; (f) LABOR joins formation through shared participants (a person who is also a disclosed 13D/13G holder links LABOR and OWNERSHIP; a person is never matched by name); (g) relationship text, detail lines, synthesis statements (with the filing as evidence) and the MAP list show it; (h) verified through the page for all ten benchmark subjects; existing ownership, capital and acquisition counts unchanged; (i) no scoring claim: LABOR coverage is one contribution, not the 8/10 objective. 3) Current implementation state: ratified 2026-10-12; gap analysis measured the source (specs/coverage-gap-analysis-four-domains-20261012.md); implementation starting. 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1402 (store), KRYL-1398 (snapshot), KRYL-1403 (formation), KRYL-1404 (synthesis). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (LABOR domain, evidence-bound, formation from admitted relationships only). KNOWLEDGE, TECHNOLOGY remain pending ratification; MEDIA observation-only.
